{{Quote|Not like I'm the first commander to see his men butchered by some drooling lunatics.|Camren|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Camren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. After Imperials wiped out his unit during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]], he became furious at them and was unfit for active duty. When the the Imperials had commandeered a power station, Camren was determined to see it destroyed and enlisted a Republic citizen to get the job done.<ref name="TOR" />
